question: What more needs to be said once awareness is known as sovereign and universal?
premises: By this alone the supreme sovereign nature of awareness is made known.
Its being the self of all is also made known.
No further defining mark is required.
inference: Once awareness is recognized as sovereign and the self of all, no additional characteristic is needed to define it.
plain_english: By this alone the supreme sovereign nature of awareness and its identity as the self of all are made known; what other defining mark need be stated?
